verdict.rationale: Sift is a fraud-detection SaaS platform, so a built-in AI assistant or copilot is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence documents only ML risk scoring, rules-based Workflows and Review Queues. None of these is an assistant that users can delegate tasks to, and adjacent automation features earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
